g.title: BOARD
g.text: Main board (Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V4.2 or V4.3)
pins by GPIO number, not header position
Leave every other GPIO unconnected (BUILD.md 9.1). Never wire GPIO 5 (V4.3 FEM) or 46 (V4.2 FEM). Leave the GNSS connector empty.

g.title: HUB
g.text: 5V rail fed from the power diagram (2/2).

g.title: ANT_LORA
g.text: Fit before ANY power, USB included.
